roads.name: SD Highway 240
words: Sweeping and steady: 31 curves in 11.1 miles.
The curves flow straight into one another.
From 2,413 to 2,720 ft, with 1,498 ft of up and down along the way.
roads.ratingNote: Bars show where it sits among the region's roads; the numbers are each part's share of the rating. At the 25 mph limit its curves ask for about 0.19 g.
